notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.5.0 - The Server Update
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers! We're excited to launch Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.5.0, bringing a major feature - player-hosted servers - alongside new content, balance tweaks, and bug fixes to enhance your journey. Dive into the details below:

Major Feature: Player-Hosted Servers

 Player-hosted servers have arrived! You can now run your own headless server for *Ancient Kingdoms* on any computer or in the cloud.

 A new server folder is included in the game directory.
 Start a server using the server.exe (server.x86_64 in Linux) executable with this command:
[code]server.exe -name "Server Name" -password "Server Password"[/code]
[code]server.x86_64 -name "Server Name" -password "Server Password"[/code]
New Content

 New Hunt: Magmadrake – Face a new challenging hunt in the world of *Ancient Kingdoms*.
 New Cooking Recipes – Discover fresh recipes to expand your culinary creations.
 New Elite in Sunken Temple: Zyrath – Challenge the new elite enemy, Zyrath, in the Sunken Temple.

 Zyrath drops the Token of Redemption, required to reset veteran skills.

Gameplay Changes

 UI Update: Adjusted the user interface for a darker, more immersive aesthetic.
 Training Dummies Enhancements:

 Added resistances to dummies, enabling testing of skills like Spell Rend and Poison Rend.
 Adjusted dummy levels, allowing players to select specific levels to test DPS.

 Minimap Update: Changed mineral colors on the minimap to grey for improved visibility.
 DoTs and Debuffs: Some high-end Damage-over-Time effects and debuffs can no longer be cleansed or purified on the first attempt.
 DEX Balance Change: Reduced critical chance bonus from Dexterity (from 0.5% to 0.4% per 10 DEX points).

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that allowed players to obtain duplicate unique items from the chest house.


We hope you enjoy this update! 

Let us know your feedback in the discussions, and happy adventuring!

Hello, adventurers! We're thrilled to release v0.6.29.0 for Ancient Kingdoms, bringing new features, gameplay enhancements, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements. Dive into the changes below and embark on your next adventure!

Urord Gatekey: Boosted drop rate for easier access.

Renewal Sage: Follow distance reduced to 15 yards.
Party EXP Bonus: Increased experience rewards in multiplayer sessions.
Mercenary/Player Buttons: Now only visible outside of combat.
Profession EXP: Increased EXP from mining, alchemy, herbalism, crafting, radiant seeker, and cooking.
Winterforge Progress: Development has reached 95%!

Balance Changes ⚖️

Cleric:

Increased mana cost for most skills.
Improved Symbol of the Arbiter.
Reduced Daunting Light damage, increased mana cost.

Ranger:

Improved Ranger's Mark and Ancestral Spirits, increased mana costs.
Ranger Mercenary: Enhanced Hunter's Sigil and Stunshot.

Druid:

Improved Early Spring and Radiant Spring.

Wizard:

Increased Arcane Blast damage and mana cost.

Bug Fixes & QoL 🛠️

Fixed mob footsteps sounding when volume is set to zero.
General performance and stability improvements.


We're incredibly grateful for your support and passion for Ancient Kingdoms. Jump in, explore the new features, and share your thoughts in the Steam Discussions! Your feedback helps shape the future of Eratiath.

Happy adventuring,
Ancient Pixels Team

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms - Major Update!
notes.notes:
Adventurers, prepare yourselves! A major update has arrived, bringing new content, balance changes, and crucial fixes to enhance your journey through Eratiath. Read on for all the details!

New Content & Features

 Epic Cleric Quest Begins! The journey to prove your faith and power has started. Will you rise to the challenge?
 New Legendary Bow – A weapon of unmatched precision has been discovered.
 New Event: The Sunken Temple – Venture into its depths and uncover hidden dangers!
 Added chat notifications when obtaining items from a chest.
 Added a new Stone Chest for housing.


Balance Updates
Wizard Adjustments:

 Increased damage of Arcane Blast.
 Reduced cast time for Ensnare.
 Increased Ice Strike stun chance up to 75% and reduced its cast time.
 Arcane Blast now deals 200-300% spell power.
 Wizard Mercenaries now gain more mana per level.


Warrior Adjustments:

 Increased aggro generated by Warrior Mercenaries.
 Tactics of War now increases attack power by 1-5%.


Rogue Adjustments:

 Sharpness now increases attack power by 1-5%.


Ranger Adjustments:

 Battle Preparations now increases attack power by 1-5%.


Healing System Update:

 Healers can now perform Exceptional Heals, based on their critical chance and Dexterity (DEX).


General Changes & Fixes

 Bosses are now immune to speed-changing effects but will still be affected by damage-over-time (DoT) effects that alter speed.
 Reduced respawn timer for Captain Aerendyl.
 Fixed Sylvaron respawning in a dead state after revival.
 Added more skills and loot to Sylvaron.
 Fixed issue with corrupted dwarves attacking while asleep.
 Fixed bug where monsters could cast spells while moving.
 Corrected text description for Path of the Adept II.
 Only high-level recipes are now non-tradable.
 Fixed mercenaries spawning behind walls.
 Primal Essence can now stack up to 2,000.
 Improved navigation in the Lone-Lands – pine trees now obstruct movement less.
 Fixed a bug causing broken equipment to appear when using a skill.
 Fixed amount text positioning in crafting slots.
 All legendary items now require a minimum level of 40.
 Fixed issue where Frostleaf Aegis granted incorrect stats.
 Corrected directions in The Path of the Adept alchemy questline.
 Increased the minimum level required to use the Skarr Shield.
 All relics are now Unique Items.
 Increased Waterstone of the Ancients drop rate from 15% to 20%.
 Fixed a bug where selling a mount while riding would not dismount the player.
 Added a warning when purchasing chests: "Chests of the same color share storage."
 When only two players are playing together, they can now hire one mercenary each.


That’s all for this update, adventurers! As always, thank you for your support, feedback, and passion for Ancient Kingdoms. Stay tuned for more updates, and may your journeys be legendary! ⚔️🔥
